children: Overview
UK SME finance platform's H1 2026 revenue rose 50% yr/yr, profit before tax quadrupled
Company upgraded FY26 guidance for revenue and profit before tax
Funding Circle to start new £25 mln share buyback after current programme ends
Outlook
Funding Circle raises FY26 revenue guidance to more than £255m, up from c.£235m
Company lifts FY26 profit before tax guidance to more than £40m, up from at least £35m
Funding Circle targets FY29 revenue of £300m-£350m and PBT margins in low to mid-20% range
Result Drivers
TERM LOANS GROWTH - Revenue and profit growth driven by strong originations, supported by product innovation and high SME demand, especially for shorter-term loans
FLEXIPAY & CREDIT CARD MOMENTUM - Significant increase in transactions and revenue from FlexiPay and Credit Card products, reflecting new customer growth and strong usage by existing customers
OPERATING LEVERAGE - Profitability improved as cost growth was outpaced by revenue growth, supporting margin expansion
